description: Settle up to 50 bets. Each selection is graded as won, lost, void, half_won, half_lost, pending or ungradeable, with a reason, a `final` flag and the score it was based on. Covers 64 markets in 20 sports, including Asian handicap quarter lines, totals, corners, bookings and player props. Football settles on 90 minutes. Paid plans.

selections.description: Bets to grade, described with the fields of an odds row from get_odds

hdp.description: The line as served. Handicaps are stated for the home side even when the bet is on away

label.description: Row label as served, required for player props (e.g., 'LeBron James (Points)')

market.description: Market name as served (e.g., 'ML', 'Spread', 'Totals', 'Corners Totals', 'Player Props')

ref.description: Your own id for the bet, echoed in the answer

side.description: home, away, draw, over, under, yes, no, odd, even, 1x, 12, x2 or none

tieRule.description: How a level score settles a moneyline in sports where bookmakers differ

name: grade_bets
